translation.app.name: VoiceMeeter
translation.status.label: Connection
translation.error.invalidCodePoint: Enter a valid hexadecimal Unicode code point.
translation.error.missingGlyph: This icon is not present in the bundled font.
translation.error.invalidGainStep: Enter a positive number up to 72 dB.
translation.error.targetOutOfRange: This channel is not available in the connected edition.
translation.error.macroOutOfRange: Enter a button ID from 0 to 79.
translation.error.unsupportedSchema: These settings use an unsupported version.
translation.error.invalidSettings: Settings could not be read. Reconfigure this action.
translation.error.apiError: VoiceMeeter could not complete the operation.
translation.help.combo: Turn for the left channel; hold and turn for the right. Tap either side to mute it.
translation.help.macro: Configure the corresponding button in VoiceMeeter MacroButtons.
translation.help.offline: Saved targets are retained while disconnected.
translation.channel.name: {{kind}} {{index}}
translation.picker.search: Search English name or code point
translation.picker.hint: Select an icon to apply it.
translation.picker.title: Choose an icon
translation.error.invalidButtonDelta: Enter a nonzero change between −72 and +72 dB.
translation.button.upperHalf: Upper half: place above a decrease key for the same channel.
translation.error.invalidButtonGain: Enter a gain between −60 and +12 dB.
translation.button.help: Adjust gain once on press, then every 0.25 seconds while held. Set gain and mute do not repeat. Faders show −60 to +12 dB. Match display settings on both keys.
translation.button.rightHalf: Right half: place to the right of a decrease key for the same channel.
translation.button.lowerHalf: Lower half: place below an increase key for the same channel.
translation.button.leftHalf: Left half: place to the left of an increase key for the same channel.
translation.button.meterNotch: Mark current level with an unlit cell
translation.palette.help: Shared across Gain Button panels. Apply copies colors; updating or deleting a preset does not change configured keys. Built-in presets are read-only; save a copy to customize.
translation.palette.name: Preset name
translation.palette.confirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Configured keys keep their colors.
translation.palette.error: Cannot update shared presets. Reopen this panel to reload; existing presets have been preserved.
translation.button.labelNegativeOnly: Enable the fader label on the decrease (left/lower) key.
translation.dial.shared: Use the same appearance on both sides
translation.button.syncPairHelp: Edits sync with the adjacent opposite half on the same channel when both keys enable sync. Labels can be edited from either half and appear only on the left/lower key.
translation.palette.includesMeter: Presets include fader, label, background and all meter colors, including muted colors.
translation.touch.title: Touch controls
translation.touch.scriptHelp: Enter Remote API commands, separated by semicolons. Up to 4096 UTF-16 units. Commands run on touch, not while editing.
translation.error.invalidScript: Use at most 4096 UTF-16 units and no NUL characters.
translation.error.scriptError: VoiceMeeter command failed. Check that it is not empty and uses supported Remote API syntax. Details are in the plugin log.
translation.selection.hold: Hold and turn for right channel
translation.selection.help: Tap a side to select it. Turn to adjust the selection; press the knob to toggle mute. Long press selects that side and runs its assigned action.
translation.selection.toggleHelp: Tap anywhere to switch to the other channel. Long press selects the touched side and runs its assigned action. Turn to adjust the selection; press the knob to toggle mute.
